Statement-II : T-Cells themselves do not secrete antibodies but help B-Cells to produce antibodies.
For the above statement-I and statement-II.
Choose the answer from given options:-
options: Statement-I is incorrect and statement-II is correct.
Statement-I is correct and statement-II is incorrect.
Both statement-I and statement-II are correct.
Both statement-I and statement-II are incorrect.

questions.question:
Assertion (A) : An antibody is represented  as H2L2.
Reason  (R) : An antibody molecule has 2 heavy chains and 2 light chains.
options: A and R both are correct and R is correct explanation of A.
A and R both are correct but R is not correct explanation of A.
A is correct but R is incorrect.
A is incorrect but R is correct.

a. Lower limbs and genitals affected.
b. Mosquito is vector.
c. Chronic inflammation.

options: Sexual stages are developed in RBCs.
Parasite reproduces asexually in liver cells bursting  the cells and releasing into the blood.
When the RBCs are ruptured a toxic substance haemozoin is released. Which is responsible for chill and high fever.
Mature infective stages (gametocytes) escape from the gut of  mosquito and migrate to salivary glands.
